# aeneid-099 — new house renderings

No new house renderings; 952 reuses XI.831.

Candidates the owner may want to fix as house renderings (plain notes, not adopted):

- XII.948–949 *Pallas te hoc volnere, Pallas / immolat et poenam scelerato ex sanguine sumit*. Drafted l "Pallas you with this wound, Pallas / sacrifices, and the penalty from your guilty blood exacts," / i "This wound is the wound of Pallas; Pallas makes an offering of you, and takes his payment out of your guilty blood," (reviewer's wording; the draft had "It is Pallas who deals you this wound, Pallas who offers you up as a victim…", changed because the "It is Pallas who…" frame is common to remembered modern versions). Built from the Latin; avoids "strikes this blow", "criminal blood" and "sacrifices you now".
- XII.895 *di me terrent et Iuppiter hostis*. Reviewed i "the gods are what frighten me, and Jupiter, who is now my enemy" (the draft had "it is the gods that frighten me, and Jupiter my enemy", close to remembered versions). Listed only because it is often quoted.
- XII.908–912 the dream simile. Drafted from the Latin; no distinctive echo noticed by the drafter; `i` rephrased in review as a precaution.
